news.title: Bhubaneswar development body opens online application process for Ekamra Residency flats
news.para: Ekamra Residency, a housing project by Bhubaneswar Development Authority, has launched its online application process. The pricing for 2BHK apartments ranges from Rs 78.36 lakh to Rs 79.94 lakh and higher for premium units. Comparatively, government housing schemes in Delhi and Mumbai offer lower-priced options for similar categories. The project’s amenities include a rooftop pool and community center, targeting an upper-middle segment.

news.title: Jaipur development body introduces verification system to curb defaulting builders
news.para: The Jaipur Development Authority has launched a comprehensive verification process targeting builders with outstanding lease dues. This initiative connects new applications to the identities of directors and promoters, enhancing accountability within the sector. As a prerequisite for proposal consideration, this consolidated database will play a critical role in evaluating submissions.

news.title: Supreme court dismisses plea against additional FAR for Great Value Realty’s Ekanam
news.para: The Supreme Court has dismissed the Great Value Sharanam Apartment Owners Association’s special leave petition against the Allahabad High Court’s July 1 judgment in the additional FAR dispute concerning Ekanam in Sector 107, Noida.

news.title: DM pushes for recovery of ₹6-crore RCs issued to Ghaziabad development body
news.para: Under a recent order from the district magistrate, the Ghaziabad Development Authority faces a recovery obligation of Rs 6 crore due to outstanding challans. This action was prompted by a complaint from a distressed homebuyer. Since 2021, UP Rera has issued 28 recovery orders against GDA, yet unpaid dues persist. A high court mandate demands swift action from GDA, with district officials ready to intervene if necessary.

news.title: Don’t use premium FAR to regularise unauthorised constructions: SC
news.para: The Supreme Court of India has delivered a significant verdict concerning the Premium floor area ratio scheme in Karnataka. This scheme permits developers to acquire extra floor space for a fee, raising pertinent issues regarding civic infrastructure. Opponents of the scheme assert that it might facilitate the regularization of illegal constructions as per the Greater Bengaluru Authority Act.

news.title: Haryana RERA orders Ocus Skycrapers to pay interest to Gurugram resident for seven-month possession delay
news.para: In a ruling by the Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority, a resident has been granted compensation due to a seven-month delay in receiving possession of their unit in the Ocus 24K project. Although serious allegations against the developer were dismissed, the authority ordered compensation at an interest rate of 10.8%.

news.title: MCD begins drone survey to improve property tax assessment in Delhi
news.para: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has launched an innovative pilot project utilizing drones to conduct property surveys across two wards. This forward-thinking initiative is designed to improve the accuracy of property tax assessments while effectively identifying unassessed properties. By leveraging advanced mapping techniques, the project aims to hasten grievance resolutions and minimize the need for manual inspections.

news.title: MCD carries out 44 demolition actions, seals 11 properties across Delhi
news.para: On September 21, the Municipal Corporation of Delhi undertook significant enforcement actions, demolishing 44 structures and sealing 11 properties across various districts. This initiative was a crucial response to unauthorized construction practices, intensified following a tragic building collapse on September 6 that claimed several lives. Areas affected included Gandhi Nagar and Ashok Vihar, with officials directed to uphold building regulations strictly.

news.title: NCLAT upholds liquidator's right to evict related-party 'tenants' from corporate debtor's property
news.para: The National Company Law Appellate Tribunal has affirmed that a liquidator possesses the authority to recover assets belonging to a corporate debtor directly. This decision pertains to Duke Fashions and UV&W Products, who were ordered to vacate certain properties. Their claims of tenancy rights based on 30-year lease deeds were rejected, as the leases lacked proper registration.

news.title: Orient Cables to launch ₹552-crore IPO on September 25
news.para: Orient Cables (India) Ltd is set to launch its IPO for investors from September 25 to September 29. With a price range between Rs 258 and Rs 272 per share, the revised offering size now stands at Rs 552 crore, mainly due to a decreased Offer for Sale. Funds raised will focus on capital expenditures and debt repayments, with an anticipated market debut on October 5.

news.title: Take action against residential properties used for commercial purpose: SC to municipal bodies
news.para: The Supreme Court of India has mandated that municipal authorities take action against residential properties being misused for commercial purposes. Authorities must prioritize identifying and sealing these properties if violations are confirmed. The court also highlighted the significant consequences that arise from these unauthorized conversions on community and environmental levels. A comprehensive inquiry will be conducted to identify residential areas misused for non-residential activities.

news.title: Chandru Raheja sells 1.49% stake in Mindspace REIT for ₹500 crore
news.para: Chandru Raheja, a prominent billionaire, has made headlines by selling a 1.49 percent stake in Mindspace Business Parks REIT. The transaction, which generated around Rs 500 crore, involved selling 99,00,990 units at an average price of Rs 505 per unit. This REIT, recognized by Sebi, manages substantial commercial properties in major cities across India.

news.title: Enforcement directorate surveys Punjab's GMADA, principal secretary office in PMLA probe
news.para: A total of 26 premises located in Mohali (SAS Nagar) and Ludhiana in Punjab, Panchkula in Haryana, Chandigarh, and Delhi were covered under the provisions of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), they said.

news.title: Runwal Enterprises’ ₹500 crore IPO to open on September 25; price band ₹290-305
news.para: Runwal Enterprises has fixed a price band of ₹290-305 per share for its ₹500 crore initial public offering. The issue will open on September 25 and close on September 29, 2026.

news.title: Chandigarh administration plans split option for large industrial plots
news.para: Under the proposed provisions, no fragmentation will be permitted for industrial plots abutting roads less than 60 ft wide. For eligible properties, each resultant plot will have to measure at least 1 kanal and have a minimum frontage of 50 ft.

news.title: Nashik civic body to hold property tax camps to bring more properties within tax net
news.para: The ward-wise camps will be held in all 31 municipal wards between 10am and 4pm during the 10-day drive to assist property owners whose properties have not yet been assessed or registered under the civic body’s property tax system.

news.title: Government will build one lakh LIG flats in CURE area: Telangana housing minister
news.para: In a significant housing initiative, the Congress government is set to erect one lakh LIG flats in highly desirable regions. Recipients will enjoy complete rights and will obtain sale deeds without incurring registration fees. A transparent lottery system will guarantee equitable applicant selection. The initial phase involves building 480 houses per constituency, aiming for completion before next year’s Bonalu festival.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh CM to launch Lucknow development body's housing schemes on September 24
news.para: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath will launch several housing schemes on September 24.  Online registration for 3,105 residential plots will also commence on this significant day.  Varun Vihar and Naimish Nagar housing projects will offer numerous plots for eager buyers.  The Chief Minister will also lay foundation stones for five new apartment complexes.  These new housing initiatives aim to provide more residential options for citizens.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh rental agreements see a five-time fee cut
news.para: The Uttar Pradesh cabinet has slashed stamp duty and registration fees for rental agreements, striving to bring rates in line with other states and promote formal registrations. Lease contracts lasting a year with rents capped at two lakh rupees will now incur a modest fee of two thousand rupees.

news.title: Starbucks to set up GCC in Chennai, hiring to begin in Q1 2027
news.para: Starbucks is set to launch a Global Capability Centre in Chennai, generating 800 high-quality job opportunities. This center will enhance Starbucks' global operational and technological functions, chosen due to Chennai's wealth of tech talent and impressive employee retention. The company aims to broaden its international coffeehouse presence. This investment signals Tamil Nadu's appeal to multinational enterprises.
